entries.title: Psalms 131:1
segments:
. This Psalm, while expressive of David's pious feelings on assuming the royal office, teaches the humble, submissive temper of a true child of God. 
 
    1. eyes lofty--a sign of pride (

entries.title: Psalms 131:2
segments: 2. Surely, &c.--The form is that of an oath or strongest assertion. Submission is denoted by the figure of a weaned child. As the child weaned by his mother from the breast, so I still the motions of pride in me (

). Hebrew children were often not weaned till three years old. 
 
    soul--may be taken for desire, which gives a more definite sense, though one included in the idea conveyed by the usual meaning, myself.
